description: Codex-only install surface used for dry-run planning, validation, and collision review.

operations.summary: Install durable global Codex guidance.
operations.conflictPolicy: Global guidance can affect every repo. External repos keep precedence through repo-local AGENTS.md files.

operations.summary: Install Codex config template for the current platform.
operations.conflictPolicy: Canonical template plus user-owned overlay: existing model, profile, approval, sandbox, project trust, and unrelated MCP values are preserved outside Force. Codex Chef-managed agent/MCP safety tables are synchronized explicitly; Force replaces the file only after backup.

operations.summary: Install the lazy project-keyed Serena pool bridge.
operations.conflictPolicy: The bridge is local-only, starts no Serena/LSP until an allowlisted semantic tool is used, and never stores a token in repository content or config.

operations.summary: Install conservative default command-approval rules.
operations.conflictPolicy: Rules allow narrow verification commands and keep destructive/publish actions approval-gated.

operations.summary: Install specialist subagent definitions.
operations.conflictPolicy: Specialists stay narrow; do not import external repo-specific agent fleets into global defaults.

operations.summary: Install named Codex profile files.
operations.conflictPolicy: Profiles stay separate files and avoid mixing beta permission profiles with legacy sandbox settings.

operations.summary: Install the local workflow plugin bundle and its reviewed SessionEnd process-hygiene hook.
operations.conflictPolicy: Managed plugin files are refreshed after backup while extra files are preserved by default; destructive pruning requires an explicit repair flag, and Codex hook trust remains a separate exact-source user review.

operations.summary: Install the Codex Chef operator workflow for direct routing-profile invocation.
operations.conflictPolicy: The operator skill is synchronized from the canonical plugin source only when the target is absent, marked as Codex Chef-managed, or an exact legacy match. A foreign collision fails before any write unless that exact target is explicitly adopted.

operations.summary: Optionally install curated global Codex skills from the locked catalog.
operations.conflictPolicy: Only locked package/skill pairs are allowed. Unmarked, foreign, or locally drifted same-name targets are preserved and skipped by default. A valid Codex Chef provenance marker permits a mandatory-backup managed upgrade; replacing any other exact target requires a separately reviewed per-skill --adopt-existing invocation.
